inputs.text: [excited] Pa… rah… seh… RA… theer… ee… um. [curious] Four little pieces, all Greek. [pauses] "Para" means beside, close to. And the tiny bit after it means "without."
[amazed] Close to the beast without a horn.

[warmly] The whole name, yes — a cousin of the rhinoceros, but without a single horn. It lived in Asia, [amazed] in Pakistan, China, and Mongolia, [pauses] thirty million years ago — long after the dinosaurs.
